summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring the QuadratureNexus→FLUME VAE→SurrealDB→Mycelium→Ouroboros feedback loop, then run a multi-agent autoresearch loop overnight until 8 AM using timeit/autodata/autoharness.
summary.outcome: Fixed 6 major Mycelium feedback bugs (E1–E62 experiments), built a compound analytics subsystem (10+ modules), repaired 1865+ tests across compound/core/flume suites, fixed FLUME VAE dual-mode architecture, and validated the full EVO closed loop: Mycelium synthesis at lr=2.0 lifts consensus from 0.725 to exactly 0.850, triggering directive witness marks and raising EVO coherence by +0.0345.

repo: The retirement criterion uses r['asi']['experiment'] (not r['experiment']), r['status'] (not r['verdict']), and r['metric'] (not r['delta']) — autoresearch.jsonl nests the experiment label under 'asi'.

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments on every call; Mycelium feedback must accumulate into _mycelium_calibration (+=) to survive across deliberations — this was the root cause of all E5/E6 failures.

SurrealDB requires time::now() for datetime fields (string literals rejected), RETURN true; for health probe (SELECT 1 returns 400), and SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields — serialize EVO biographies to the result field as JSON.

The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically reverts the working tree to HEAD by replaying stash/restore — use git checkout HEAD -- <file> to recover, and always stage only specific files to avoid LFS pointer conflicts.
autoresearch.jsonl is a runtime log tracked via LFS causing pointer/content conflicts in pre-commit stash cycles — add it to .gitignore and git rm --cached it.

The psutil resource guardrail blocks CompoundExecutor tests on high-CPU machines — the compound conftest must mock BOTH psutil.virtual_memory (percent/total/available) AND psutil.cpu_percent, not just memory.

Pre-commit uses KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 to bypass the Kaggle branch guard; format with ruff format before staging to avoid the hook running ruff --fix which can trigger the stash/restore LFS conflict cycle.

IEEE 754 edge case: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 in Python due to floating-point rounding — result.approved (which uses >= comparison against the stored constant) is authoritative; never use float mean to check threshold crossing.
vault_find_relevant_context is async; skill_selector.py called it without await in synchronous code — use vault_search() (sync wrapper) instead to avoid RuntimeWarning and test failures.

FlumeVAE.forward() returned 3 values historically but tests expected 4 — the z reparameterization sample was silently dropped in a refactor; always return (recon, mu, log_var, z) to maintain caller stability.

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback used SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle 2 to undo cycle 1. Fixed to accumulate via _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment then flush to _score_adjustments. The convergence formula is consensus_n = 0.85 - 0.125*(1-lr/2)^n, validated to max_error=0.00025.

forward() returned (logits, mu, log_var) — 3 values — but all callers expected 4. Added z (reparameterized sample) as the 4th return value. Also added eval-mode determinism: reparameterize() returns mu directly when not self.training. Added legacy MLP mode via FlumeVAE(input_dim=768, latent_dim=256) for backward compatibility.

recon, mu, logvar, _z = self.model(data) failed with 'not enough values to unpack (expected 4, got 3)'. Fixed by using the new 4-value forward() return. Also fixed cosine similarity for token models: use recon.argmax(dim=-1).float() not raw logits tensor.

All self.mcp.vault_write() calls were synchronous but vault_write is async — caused RuntimeWarning 'coroutine was never awaited'. Fixed by replacing all with vault_write_sync(), vault_read_sync(), vault_delete_sync() wrappers.

Called self.mcp_client.vault_find_relevant_context(query, project=project) without await in synchronous select_skills(). Fixed to use self.mcp_client.vault_search(query, limit=10) which is the correct sync wrapper.
analyze_cache_effectiveness was marked async but contained no real async I/O. Tests called it without await causing TypeError. Fixed by removing the async keyword.

HookifyValidator was missing set_lever_position(), get_lever_positions(), list_override_keys(), clear_lever_overrides() methods that tests expected. Added all four with a three-tier write-ahead log pattern (git/surreal/vault with best-effort fallback).

AxiomaticState was missing check_precipitation() method. Implemented as a struct combining HIHO threshold test (coherence > 0.5), Shannon entropy H = -p*log2(p)-(1-p)*log2(1-p), and thermodynamic free energy F = E - TS. Required explicit bool() casts to avoid returning np.bool_ which broke isinstance checks.

test_flume_paraphrases_closer_than_unrelated was flaky because the mock used an advancing RNG counter — v1 and v2 had correlation -0.034 < -0.029 anti-correlating the assertion. Fixed with deterministic category-fixed vectors based on text content.

Compound test conftest only mocked psutil.virtual_memory. Machine at 99.4% CPU caused silicon_guard to block execute_task in 16 tests. Added patch('psutil.cpu_percent', return_value=25.0) as autouse fixture alongside the existing memory mock.

Hand-written mock_get_context function didn't accept **kwargs but _get_flux_context passed sources=None as a keyword. TypeError was swallowed by bare except, returning [] and making 18 tests report wrong behavior. Fixed by adding **kwargs to mock signature.

log_result() signature is log_result(run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment). E71-E76 experiments were calling it as log_result(delta, metrics_dict, description, experiment=...) — missing 'run' as first arg and 'status' as 4th arg, shifting all others wrong.

workflow: Surgical commit playbook: run ruff format + ruff check --select=F,E9,E501 --fix manually, use git add <specific files> not git add -A, stash with git stash push --keep-index before committing to avoid pre-commit stash/LFS conflicts.

When unittest.TestCase tests call async methods: patch httpx.AsyncClient (not httpx.Client), use AsyncMock for all awaitable methods (post, aclose), wrap every client call with asyncio.run(). Mock content format must include type:text key per FastMCP protocol.

V-model structural invariants (inspect.signature checks) run ~1ms and catch refactor drift before behavioral tests run — a structural test suite is a force multiplier for large codebases with active refactoring.

The HIHO balance (0.5 threshold) as exploit/explore decision boundary applies recursively: to experiment scheduling, to autoresearch analysis, and to Mycelium synthesis — a single principle governing multiple system layers.

Experiment retirement criterion: CV(last-10-keeps) < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 signals convergence. Constant-output experiments (E50, E12 at 0.8164) retire; variable experiments with CV > 0.05 stay active.

Multi-agent team pattern: spawn independent research/fix/harness agents concurrently, use TaskCreate/TaskUpdate to track work, SendMessage to coordinate — enables 3-5x parallel throughput on independent subtasks.

The compound analytics subsystem (experiment_analytics, experiment_scheduler, session_metrics_aggregator, health_monitor, loop_visualizer) should be built as small focused modules (<100 lines each) rather than one monolithic tracker.

friction: Entire.io checkpoint daemon reverted working tree to HEAD multiple times per hour, destroying uncommitted work — required constant git checkout HEAD -- <file> recovery and made large edits risky.
LFS pointer/content conflict on autoresearch.jsonl caused pre-commit stash/restore to fail with 'File exists' — blocked all commits until the file was untracked.
Lemonade LLM server entered silent failure state (returning empty strings for all evaluation prompts) after extended overnight load, requiring heuristic fallback mode for remaining experiments.
System swap fully exhausted (39Gi/39Gi) due to Node.js (20GB) and next-server (130% CPU) processes unrelated to the work — not fixable without system intervention.

ruff-quick pre-commit hook modifying staged files between stash and restore caused the 'pre-commit stash/restore' step to fail for any commit touching multiple files — required manual ruff format run before every commit.
Multiple overnight_evo_loop.py processes accumulated without cleanup as each session restarted, consuming memory until explicit pkill.
The Gemini worktree (.gemini/worktrees/...) was cleaned up mid-session, destroying 3500+ lines of E55-E62 experiment code that hadn't been committed to main.
open_items: E5 original metric (alignment_score rises >= 0.05 after one Mycelium synthesis cycle) was never definitively validated with real LLM voices — E55-E62 used heuristic mode; needs LLM-mode rerun.
JEPA persistent learning (E43/E46) shows no cross-run improvement due to catastrophic forgetting — needs replay buffer with distributional diversity, not just repetition of the same attractor point.

8 compound test state-leakage failures pass individually but fail in full suite order — root cause is ExecutorFactory singleton not being reset between test files; requires per-file setup_method()/teardown_method() reset.
ExperimentScheduler is implemented and tested but not wired into overnight_evo_loop.py main loop for automatic experiment retirement and replacement.
FLUME CLI tests (test_cli_train.py) have SIGSEGV failures from GPU stack during ROCm initialization — requires hardware/driver investigation, not code fixes.

SurrealDB journey_point writes are bypassed for E55-E62 style experiments that call nexus.deliberate() directly (instead of run_llm_deliberation) — EVO biographies from these experiments are not persisted.
E71-E76 experiments were smoke-tested in heuristic mode only; production validation with real Lemonade LLM voices not yet done.

The compound_analytics_cli.py, compound_engine.py, and related analytics modules (loop_visualizer, experiment_correlator) need to be wired into the overnight loop's end-of-iteration summary print to surface HIHO balance in real time.

Ouroboros (ouroboros_bridge.py) fires 320+ HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (false alarms) — needs a filter to distinguish real production drift from experiment-induced resets.
